name: BIOSSES
description: BIOSSES is a benchmark dataset for semantic sentence similarity estimation in the biomedical domain. It consists of 100 sentence pairs manually annotated by experts, enabling evaluation of models that compute semantic similarity using string, vector, and ontology-based methods.
reputation: Used for evaluating biomedical semantic similarity models; improves over generic domain-independent systems.
notes: Includes ontology-based similarity measures; dataset and code publicly available.
